The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Inzira y'Umusaraba, Umuji wa Kera wa Yeruzalemu
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Kuva mu Gihe co hagati, abasiguruzi basengera amasitasiyo y'Inzira y'Umusaraba muri uyu muhanda, kuva ku Kigo ca Antoniya kugeza i Kaluvari; buri wa Gatanu Abafaransisikani bayobora umutambagiro. Inzira nyayo Umwami wacu yanyuzemo iterwa n'aho Pilato yamuciriye urubanza.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Abakirisitu bubaha aha hantu kuva ku bisekuruza vya mbere; Mutagatifu Helena na Konsitantini bubatse bazilika hejuru y'urutare rwa Kaluvari n'imva irimo ubusa, kandi ubu Abafaransisikani ni bo bahakorera.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka avuga intera ya sitadi mirongo itandatu uvuye i Yeruzalemu (Luke 24:13). Hubahwa ahantu hatatu: Emawusi Nikopoli, herekanwa hano; El-Kubeyibe, harindwa n'Abafaransisikani; na Abu Goshi.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Ekleziya y'Ubutware bwa Mutagatifu Petero, Tabuga
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Ekleziya nto y'amabuye y'umukara ku nkombe y'amazi, yubatswe ikikije urutare rwitwa «Mensa Christi» (Ameza ya Kristu), aho ukurikije uruhererekane yateguriye Intumwa ifunguro rya mu gitondo.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Ekleziya y'Imva ya Mariya, igikombe ca Kedironi
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Nibura kuva mu kinyejana ca gatanu, Ekleziya y'i Yeruzalemu yubaha iyi mva munsi y'Umusozi w'Imizeti, iruhande rwa Getsemani, nk'aho Umuvyeyi w'Imana yajanywe mu ijuru. Ikigo c'abamonaki c'Isinzira ku musozi wa Siyoni cibutsa ugusinzira kwe; uruhererekane rundi ruvuga ko imyaka ye ya nyuma yayimaranye na Mutagatifu Yohana muri Efezi.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Shapeli y'Ijanwa mu ijuru, Umusozi w'Imizeti
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka avuga ko yabajanye «kugera i Betaniya» (Luke 24:50), naho Ivyakozwe n'Intumwa bivuga ko bavuye ku Musozi w'Imizeti (Acts 1:12). Shapeli nto iri ku mpinga ibitse ibuye ryubahwa nk'iriri ho ikirenge ce ca nyuma.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Malayika Gaburiyeli aramutsa Bikira wuzuye inema. Igihe asubije ati «bimbeho uko ubivuze», Jambo yigira umuntu mu nda ye.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Mariya ajana Umwami wacu kwa mwene wabo Elizabeti. Yohana asimbukira mu nda kubera akanyamuneza, Elizabeti amwita «Nyina w'Umwami wanje», maze Mariya aririmba Magnifikati.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Mu muji wa Dawudi, Umwami wacu avuka kuri Bikira Mariya, azingirwa mu myenda maze aryamishwa mu kiraro, kuko batari babonye umwanya mu icumbi.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Malayika atangaza «Umukiza, ari we Kristu Umwami», maze ingabo zo mu ijuru ziririmba ziti «Imana nisingizwe mu ijuru». Abashumba bihuta baja gushaka Umwana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Abanyabwenge baturutse iburasirazuba bakurikira inyenyeri ye, basanga Umwana na Mariya nyina, maze bamutura zahabu, ububani n'ishangi.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Mariya na Yozefu batura Umwana Umwami. Simewoni amuterura mu maboko, amwita «urumuri ruzamurikira amahanga», maze abwira Mariya ko inkota izahinguranya umutima we.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Yaburiwe mu nzozi, Mutagatifu Yozefu avyuka nijoro ajana Umwana na nyina mu Misiri, kure y'ukuboko kwa Herodi, kugira ngo huzuzwe ngo: «Nahamagaye umwana wanje avuye mu Misiri» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Herodi amaze gupfa, Umuryango Mutagatifu utura i Nazareti, maze «umwana arakura, agira imbaraga, yuzura ubwenge, kandi inema y'Imana yari kumwe na we».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Afite imyaka cumi n'ibiri, asigara i Yeruzalemu nyuma ya Pasika. Ku munsi wa gatatu, Mariya na Yozefu bamusanga hagati y'abigisha: «Ntimwari muzi ko ngomba kuba mu by'Data?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Mu myaka nka mirongo itatu aba i Nazareti, yumvira Mariya na Yozefu, akora umwuga w'ububaji, kandi akura mu bwenge, mu gihagararo no mu inema imbere y'Imana n'abantu.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Yohana amubatiza muri Yorudani. Ijuru rirakinguka, Roho Mutagatifu amanuka nk'inuma, maze ijwi rya Data rivuga riti: «Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda cane, unyizihira.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Roho amujana mu butayu, aho asiba iminsi mirongo ine n'amajoro mirongo ine, kandi atsinda ibishuko vya Sekibi akoresheje Ijambo ry'Imana.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Yohana amwerekana ati: «Dore Ntama w'Imana.» Andereya azana umuvandimwe we Simoni, uwo Yezu yita Kefa, ari vyo kuvuga Petero; Filipo na Natanayeli baramukurikira.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Ku ijambo rya Nyina, «Ico ababwira cose mugikore», ahindura amazi divayi, ikimenyetso ce ca mbere, maze abigishwa be batangira kumwemera.
The Wedding Feast at Cana: Yezu yigaragaza mu bukwe bw'i Kana
To Jesus through Mary: Kugera kuri Yezu tunyuze kuri Mariya
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Pasika ya mbere: ishaka ry'inzu ya Data
He drives the money changers from the Te: Yirukana abavunjaga amafaranga mu Ngoro kandi nijoro yigisha Nikodemu ko umuntu agomba kuvuka mu mazi no muri Roho. «Koko Imana yakunze isi cane, bigeza aho itanga Umwana wayo w'ikinege.»
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Ananiwe ku manywa y'ihangu, asaba umugore w'Umusamariya amazi yo kunywa, maze amuha amazi y'ubuzima, «isoko y'amazi adudubiza ubugingo bw'iteka». Benshi bo mu muji we baremera.
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Umutware w'umwami wo muri Kafarinawumu amwinginga ngo aze. «Genda, umwana wawe ni muzima.» Muri iyo saha nyine umwana arakira.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Mu isinagogi asoma mu gitabo ca Yesaya, «Roho wa Umwami ari kuri je», hanyuma aravuga ati: «Uyu munsi iki canditswe kirujujwe.» Abenewabo bamujana ku manga y'umusozi, ariko anyura hagati yabo arigendera.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Abafaransisikani bubaha Umusozi w'Isimbuka mu majepfo y'umuji nk'umusozi uvugwa muri Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Avuye i Nazareti, atura i Kafarinawumu ku nkombe y'inyanja, maze atangira kwigisha: «Igihe kirageze, Ingoma y'Imana yegereje. Nimwisubireho kandi mwemere Inkuru Nziza.»
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Ku nkombe ahamagara Simoni na Andereya, Yakobo na Yohana: «Nimunkurikire, nzabagira abarovyi b'abantu.» Nyuma y'uburovyi butangaje, basiga vyose baramukurikira.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Yigisha afite ububasha mu isinagogi, akiza umuntu roho mbi, avyutsa nyirabukwe wa Petero mu muriro, maze izuba rirenze umuji wose uteranira ku muryango.
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Incuti zimanura ikimuga zinyuze ku gisenge; Yezu amubabarira ivyaha maze amutegeka kugenda. Hanyuma ahamagara Levi, ari we Matayo, ku biro by'imisoro: «Nkurikira.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Yigisha Amahirwe, «Hahirwa abakene ku mutima, kuko Ingoma y'ijuru ari iyabo», itegeko risha ry'urukundo, n'isengesho rya Data wa twese uri mw'ijuru.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Umutware w'abasirikare b'Abaroma aravuga ati: «Umwami, ntibinkwiye ko winjira mu nzu yanje, ariko vuga ijambo gusa.» Ekleziya isubiramo amagambo ye mbere yo guhazwa muri buri Misa.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Agirira impuhwe umupfakazi wari ugiye guhamba umwana we w'ikinege, akora ku gitanda c'umurambo: «Wa musore we, ndabikubwiye, vyuka!» maze amusubiza nyina.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Mu munsi mukuru i Yeruzalemu akiza umuntu wari umaze imyaka mirongo itatu n'umunani arwaye: «Haguruka, ufate ingovyi yawe ugende.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Inkubi ikaze yuzuza ubwato amazi, we asinziriye. Akangara umuyaga: «Ceceka! Tuza!» maze haba ituze ryinshi. «Uyu ni nde, ko n'umuyaga n'inyanja bimwumvira?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Hakurya y'inkombe akiza umuntu wababazwaga na roho mbi nyinshi, zoherezwa mu mukumbi w'ingurube. Uwo muntu amwinginga ngo bajane, ariko yoherezwa kwamamaza ivyo Umwami yamukoreye.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Umugore akira akoze ku mwambaro we, maze afata ukuboko k'umukobwa wa Yayiro wapfuye: «Talita kumu», bisobanura ngo: «Mukobwa, ndabikubwiye, vyuka!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Akoresheje imigati itanu n'amafi abiri atunga rubanda, yubura amaso aja mu ijuru, ashimira kandi amanyagura imigati, maze hakusanywa inkangara cumi n'evyiri zuzuye ibisigaye.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Mu gicuku ca nyuma aza abasanga agenda hejuru y'inyanja. Petero agenda amusanga, atangira kurohama maze arataka ati: «Umwami, nkiza!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Mu isinagogi y'i Kafarinawumu yigisha: «Ni je mugati w'ubugingo… Urya umubiri wanje kandi akanywa amaraso yanje afite ubugingo bw'iteka.» Petero arasubiza ati: «Umwami, twasanga nde?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Umuvyeyi w'umunyamahanga amwinginga ku bw'umukobwa we: «N'ibibwana birya ubuvungukira bugwa ku meza ya ba shebuja.» «Mugore, ukwemera kwawe ni kunini!»
Ephphatha, and Four Thousand Fed: Efata, no gutunga abantu ibihumbi bine
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Afungura amatwi y'igipfamatwi, «Efata», bisobanura ngo «Fungurwa!», maze akoresheje imigati irindwi atunga ibihumbi bine bari bamaranye na we iminsi itatu.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Abafarizayi n'Abasaduseyi bamusaba ikimenyetso kivuye mu ijuru. Ababwira ko nta kindi kimenyetso bazahabwa uretse ikimenyetso ca Yonas.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Afata impumyi ukuboko, ayijana inyuma y'akagari, maze ayirambikaho ibiganza incuro evyiri, kugeza ibonye vyose neza.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Naho mwebwe muvuga ko ndi nde?» Petero arasubiza ati: «Uri Kristu, Umwana w'Imana nzima.» «Uri Petero, kandi kuri urwo rutare nzubakaho Ekleziya yanje… Nzaguha imfunguzo z'Ingoma y'ijuru.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Imbere ya Petero, Yakobo na Yohana, uruhanga rwe rurabagirana nk'izuba, Musa na Eliya baganira na we, maze Data aravuga ati: «Uyu ni Umwana wanje nkunda… Nimumwumve.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Acaha imiji yakoreyemo ibitangaza vyinshi, Korazini, Betsayida na Kafarinawumu, kuko itisubiyeho.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petero abona umusoro w'Ingoro mu kanwa k'ifi. Hanyuma Yezu ahagarika umwana hagati yabo: «Nimutisubiraho ngo mumere nk'abana bato, ntimuzinjira mu Ngoma y'ijuru.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Mu mbuga z'Ingoro yigisha: «Ufite inyota wese naze aho ndi anywe», ababarira umugore wafatiwe mu busambanyi, «Genda, kandi uhereye ubu ntuzongere gucumura», maze atangaza ati: «Ndi urumuri rw'isi.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Asiga ivyondo ku maso y'umuntu wavutse ari impumyi maze amwohereza kwiyuhagira mu kidendezi ca Silowe. Agaruka abona maze aramuramya: «Umwami, ndemera.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marita aramwakira, naho Mariya yicara ku birenge vye yumva. «Mariya yihitiyemo umugabane mwiza, kandi ntazawunyagwa.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Luka avuga gusa «mu kagari kamwe»; Yohana avuga Betaniya nk'urugo rwa Marita na Mariya (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Igihe umwe mu bigishwa amusavye kubigisha gusenga, abaha isengesho rya Data wa twese uri mw'ijuru.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luka ntavuga aho vyabereye; uruhererekane ruvyibukira mu buvumo bwa Eleona ku Musozi w'Imizeti. Matayo atanga iryo sengesho mu Nyigisho yo ku Musozi (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Agenda mu ibaraza rya Salomoni mu gihe c'imbeho, aravuga ati: «Intama zanje zumva ijwi ryanje… Jye na Data turi umwe.»
Asubira aho Yohana yabatirizaga mbere. Yigisha ko ico Imana yafatanyije umuntu atagomba kugitandukanya, kandi aha abana umugisha: «Nimureke abana bansange.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Ni je zuka n'ubugingo.» Yezu arira ku mva y'incuti ye, hanyuma arangurura ijwi ati: «Lazaro, sohoka!» maze uwari wapfuye asohoka akiziritswe n'imyenda.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Igihe inama nkuru igambiriye kumwica, yihugika hamwe n'abigishwa be mu muji uri hafi y'ubutayu witwa Efurayimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Impumyi Baritimeyo itaka iti: «Yezu, Mwana wa Dawudi, ngirira impuhwe!» maze irahumuka. Zakewusi yurira igiti c'umusukoma ngo amubone: «Uyu munsi agakiza kinjiye muri iyi nzu.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Habura iminsi itandatu ngo Pasika igere, Mariya asiga ibirenge vye amavuta ahumura ya naridi y'igiciro kinini, maze inzu yuzura impumuro. Avyakira nk'isigwa ry'amavuta ry'ihambwa rye.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Yinjira i Yeruzalemu ahetswe n'icana c'indogobe mu gihe rubanda risasa imyambaro n'amashami: «Hozana Mwana wa Dawudi! Hasingizwe uje mu izina rya Umwami!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Abonye umuji, arawuririra: «Iyaba nawe uyu munsi wari uzi icakuzanira amahoro!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Ahirika ameza, «Inzu yanje izitwa inzu y'isengesho ku mahanga yose», kandi ashima umupfakazi w'umukene watuye uduceri twe tubiri twa nyuma.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Yicaye ku Musozi w'Imizeti ahateganye n'Ingoro, avuga ku gusenyuka kwayo no ku kuza kwe mu ikuzo: «Ico mwakoreye umwe muri aba bavandimwe banje baciye bugufi, ni je mwagikoreye.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Yoza ibirenge by'abigishwa be maze, afashe umugati na divayi, aravuga ati: «Iki ni umubiri wanje… Iyi nkongoro ni isezerano risha mu maraso yanje… Muje mubikora mwibuka»; atyo aha Ekleziya Ukaristiya n'ubupadiri.
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Ari mu ishavu ryinshi arasenga, maze ivyuya vye biba nk'ibitonyanga by'amaraso: «Data… ntibibe uko je nshaka, ahubwo uko wowe ushaka.» Yuda aza ari kumwe n'igitero maze amugambanira amusoma.
Before Caiaphas; Peter's Denial: Imbere ya Kayifa; uguhakana kwa Petero
Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Aboshe, bamujana kwa Ana no ku muherezabitambo mukuru Kayifa maze bamucira urubanza rwo gutuka Imana. Mu rugo, Petero amuhakana gatatu; inkoko irabika, maze Petero ararira cane.
Pilate finds no guilt in Him and sends H: Pilato ntiyamubonaho icaha maze amwohereza kwa Herodi, umushinyagurira akamusubiza. Rubanda rusaba Baraba, maze Pilato abemerera.
\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: «Nuko Pilato afata Yezu, aramukubitisha.» «Ibikomere vye ni vyo vyadukijije» (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Abasirikare baboha ikamba ry'amahwa, bamwambika umwenda w'umuhemba maze baramushinyagurira: «Ndakuramutsa, Mwami w'Abayahudi!» Pilato amusohokana: «Nguyu umuntu!» maze amutanga ngo abambwe.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Yikoreye umusaraba we, asohoka aja i Kaluvari. Simoni w'i Sirene ahatirwa kumufasha, maze abwira abagore barira ati: «Bakobwa b'i Yeruzalemu, ntimundirire, ahubwo nimwiririre kandi muririre abana banyu.»
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Abambwa hagati y'abagizi ba nabi babiri. «Data, bababarire, kuko batazi ico bakora.» «Uyu munsi uraba uri kumwe nanje mu ijuru.» «Muvyeyi, dore umwana wawe… Dore nyoko.» «Birarangiye.» Yubika umutwe maze atanga roho.
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Yozefu w'Arimatiya na Nikodemu bazingira umubiri we mu myenda y'ihariri hamwe n'imibavu, maze bamushira mu mva nsha yacukuwe mu rutare, mu murima uri hafi y'aho yabambiwe.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Ku munsi wa mbere w'icumweru, imva irimo ubusa. Umwami wazutse ahamagara Mariya Madalena mu izina rye maze amwohereza ku Ntumwa: «Nabonye Umwami.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Atamenyekanye, agendana n'abigishwa babiri maze abasobanurira Ivyanditswe, nuko bamumenya igihe amanyagura umugati. «Mbese imitima yacu ntiyagurumanaga muri twe?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Inzugi zikinze, ahagarara hagati y'Intumwa maze abahumekeraho: «Nimwakire Roho Mutagatifu. Abo muzababarira ivyaha bazaba babibabariwe», maze nyuma y'icumweru Tomasi aremeza ati: «Umwami wanje, Mana yanje!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Mu museke ku kiyaga yuzuza inshundura zabo kandi abategurira ifunguro rya mu gitondo. Abaza Petero gatatu ati: «Urankunda?» maze gatatu amushinga ati: «Ragira intama zanje.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Ku musozi wo muri Galileya yohereza Cumi n'umwe: «Nimugende rero, mwigishe amahanga yose, mubabatiza mu izina rya Data, n'iry'Umwana, n'irya Roho Mutagatifu… Dore ndi kumwe namwe iminsi yose kugeza ku ndunduro y'isi.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Matayo ntavuga izina ry'umusozi. Abasiguruzi akenshi bavyibukira ku Musozi w'Amahirwe; abandi batekereza Tabori cangwa umusozi wa Aribeli.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Iminsi mirongo ine nyuma ya Pasika aha Intumwa umugisha, abasezeranya Roho Mutagatifu, maze ajanwa mu ijuru bareba; basubira i Yeruzalemu bafite akanyamuneza vyinshi.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Iminsi mirongo itanu nyuma ya Pasika, igihe Intumwa zari zihuje umutima mu isengesho hamwe na Mariya, Nyina wa Yezu, Roho Mutagatifu abamanukiraho mu ndimi z'umuriro. Petero yamamaza Kristu wabambwe akazuka, abantu nk'ibihumbi bitatu barabatizwa, maze Ekleziya ija mu mahanga yose.
The Assumption of Our Lady: Ijanwa mu ijuru rya Bikira Mariya
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Igihe ubuzima bwe bwo ku isi burangiye, Umuvyeyi w'Imana Utasamanywe icaha, Bikira Mariya iteka, yajanywe mu ikuzo ry'ijuru ari roho n'umubiri, nk'uko Papa Piyo XII yabitangaje ku mugaragaro mu 1950. Uwavyaye Umwami ni we wa mbere usangira izuka ry'Umwana we.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Ivyanditswe ntibivuga aho vyabereye. Herekanwa ku mva aho Ekleziya y'i Yeruzalemu kuva kera ihimbaza ijanwa rye mu ijuru.
Her Son crowns the Blessed Virgin Queen: Umwana we yimika Bikira w'umuhire nk'Umwamikazi w'ijuru n'isi, Umwamikazi w'abamalayika n'abatagatifu. «Nuko mu ijuru haboneka ikimenyetso gikomeye: umugore wambaye izuba, ukwezi kuri munsi y'ibirenge vye, no ku mutwe we ikamba ry'inyenyeri cumi n'evyiri.»
This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Iri yobera ribera mu ijuru; ryerekanwa hano hamwe n'ijanwa rye mu ijuru.
The Coronation of Mary: Iyimikwa rya Mariya nk'Umwamikazi w'ijuru n'isi
Mondays and Saturdays, and the Sundays o: Ku wa mbere no ku wa gatandatu, ku cumweru ca Adiventi n'ic'igihe ca Noheli
Tuesdays and Fridays, and the Sundays of: Ku wa kabiri no ku wa gatanu, ku cumweru c'Igisibo
Wednesdays and Sundays: Ku wa gatatu no ku cumweru
The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rozari yavutse mu isengesho rya Ekleziya. Abamonaki baririmbaga zaburi 150, naho abakirisitu batazi gusoma basengaga Data wa twese uri mw'ijuru 150, nyuma Ndakuramukije Mariya 150, bazibara ku mugozi uriho udusaro: «Zaburi za Mariya».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Ukurikije uruhererekane rukundwa, Bikira Mariya yahaye Rozari Mutagatifu Dominiko i Puruye mu Bufaransa mu ntangiriro z'ikinyejana ca 13, ngo imufashe mu kwigisha arwanya ubuyobe bw'Abalibijwa. Umuryango we, Umuryango w'Abigisha, wayikwirakwije mu bukirisitu bwose, maze mu kinyejana ca 15 Umuhire Alani wa La Roshe, w'Umudominikani, avugurura ubwo bwitange kandi ashinga imiryango ya mbere ya Rozari.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mutagatifu Papa Piyo V, na we w'Umudominikani, yahaye Rozari imiterere yayo isanzwe y'amayobera cumi n'atanu, ay'Akanyamuneza, ay'Ububabare n'ay'Ikuzo, mu 1569. Nyuma y'intsinzi ya Lepante ku wa 7 Ukwakira 1571, yabonetse ubukirisitu bwose buvuga Rozari, yagize uwo munsi umunsi mukuru wa Bikira Mariya w'Intsinzi, ubu ni urwibutso rwa Bikira Mariya wa Rozari. I Lurude n'i Fatima, Bikira ubwe yaje afite Rozari maze asaba ko ivugwa buri munsi.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Ku wa 16 Ukwakira 2002, Mutagatifu Papa Yohana Pawulo II yongeyeho amayobera atanu y'Urumuri, aturuka mu buzima bwa rubanda bw'Umwami wacu, mu ibaruwa ye y'intumwa Rosarium Virginis Mariae, kugira ngo Rozari ibe «incamake y'Ivanjili». Muri buri yobera dutekereza uruhanga rwa Kristu tureba n'amaso ya Nyina.
